content.text: It's pretty common for an 8-year-old to have stretches of waking at night, especially when the schedule shifts or something is on her mind. Tonight, try a calm 10-minute chat before lights out. Ask what's on her mind and let her say it out loud. If she still wakes at 2am, keep it boring: walk her back to bed with few words and low light. If it keeps up for weeks, or comes with snoring or daytime exhaustion, mention it to her doctor.
